title: Edit Everything
body:
Edit Everything: Turn screenshots into editable elements, | BetaList

## Turn screenshots into editable elements, drag, drop, and restyle on mobile

Edit Everything lets you drop in screenshots and turns them into editable elements so you can directly interact and use AI control to modify any part. You can rewrite text, drag and drop, reshape elements, or restyle the whole scene using a prompt, then export in the format you need. Create visuals based on existing designs or modify visuals if screenshots aren't suited for presentation or marketing. Refine visuals quickly and keep outputs on brand. It’s fully supported on mobile, so you can create anywhere using interactive and AI controls.

 Charlie

title: Eikna
body:
EIKNA: Discover trusted romance reads by mood, trope, heat, | BetaList

## Discover trusted romance reads by mood, trope, heat, and vibe

 

 

 

EIKNA is a human-reviewed romance discovery platform that helps you find books based on what matters to you. Editors read and evaluate every title, then map it by mood, trope, heat, pacing, and representation so recommendations fit your taste rather than popularity trends. You can browse curated lesbian and sapphic collections, explore by trope or vibe, ask Lyra for suggestions, and create a free account to save books, track reading, and refine your personal Reader DNA. EIKNA's editors also review and recommend lesbian and sapphic romance at LesbianRomanceReads.com, a companion site for readers who want deeper takes on specific titles.

# Swytch: Run a Redis-compatible cache with database-level | BetaList

title: Swytch
body:
Swytch: Run a Redis-compatible cache with database-level | BetaList

## Run a Redis-compatible cache with database-level consistency

 

Swytch is a leaderless, Redis-compatible cache that delivers database-level consistency across regions. Every node accepts writes, serves reads, and follows the same order of operations, eliminating single points of failure and leader elections. Keep your existing Redis clients and connect without changes. Self-host it free under AGPL or use Swytch Cloud for a zero-knowledge control plane and durability options, enabling active-active setups and EU data sovereignty.

body:

## Edit videos in the browser with automatic cuts, captions, and export

 

 

NinjaClip is a browser-based video editor that automates tedious tasks so you can publish quickly. FortripAI is travel decision infrastructure for complex trips. body:
